thread:
Alex: Quick sync — launching Project Corridor (customer pilot) next quarter. We need to lock dependent work: runtime prewarm, dedicated capacity slots, security review for KMS. Proposed launch corridor: feature freeze week 1, canary week 2, GA week 4. Thoughts?
Priya: Sounds tight. Runtime needs a small change to batching policy for low-latency tail: prefer immediate flush at <20ms for pilot.
Morgan: Dedicated pool can give the slots but need a 2-week runway to procure GPU instances and test autoscaler. Can we shift canary +1 week?
Alex: We can consider shifting. Customer expects pilot mid-quarter though. Any mitigations?
Kevin: We can partial-mitigate with prefix caching and prewarm on hot routes. I'll add a lightweight prewarm hook. Estimate 4 days to implement + tests.
Tomas: Security: KMS integration needs an external review and HSM key rotation doc. We can fast-track if usage is scoped and we sign off on encryption-in-transit only. Otherwise it'll add ~3 weeks.
Sam: Can we scope pilot to non-PHI customers to avoid the HSM requirement? That would speed security signoff.
Alex: Yes — propose pilot = non-PHI customers only. That avoids HSM requirement. OK?
Tomas: Works for me. We'll still need key management checklist though.
Priya: On runtime side, I'll target a feature branch for batching policy + prewarm hook. Can we get capacity reservation details from Morgan to run perf tests?
Morgan: Putting tentative capacity request: 4xA10G per zone during canary, autoscale down after. Will open infra ticket: INFRA-4521.
Kevin: Linking test harness: https://ci.redwood.internal/builds/hover-test-233
Alex: Great. Can we align on acceptance criteria? My draft:
- 95th percentile latency <= 400ms on pilot traffic
- No more than 0.5% error rate during canary
- KMS keys rotating validated + audit logs enabled
- Rollback plan documented
Sam: Add cost threshold for pilot: <$2k/day for dedicated capacity, otherwise pause.
Priya: Ack on metrics. Will put perf dashboard and alert thresholds.
Tomas: Security will sign off if KMS audit logs visible and non-PHI scope confirmed.
Alex: Next steps: Priya + Kevin to land runtime changes by Thu (4 days); Morgan to create INFRA-4521 by EOD; Tomas to outline KMS checklist by Tue; Sam to update pilot cohort list. Check-in Friday 11am. @deploy-bot please create calendar reminder.
deploy-bot: Reminder created: #project-corridor sync Friday 11:00 — https://calendar.link/corridor
Kevin: I'll start the prewarm prototype today. Ping me for performance numbers.
Priya: I'll draft the batching change and share a small benchmark by Wednesday.
Morgan: Got it. Reserving tentative slots, will update ticket with instance IDs.
Alex: Thanks team. If anything blocks, drop into this thread. :thumbsup:
